newsitem.title: USA: Converse settles Apex claims, reaps gain.
newsitem.headline: Converse settles Apex claims, reaps gain.

text.p: Converse Inc said on Wednesday it settled substantially all of its remaining claims against the former owners of Apex One Inc, which Converse acquired in May 1995.

The settlements, combined with the confirmation of a plan of orderly liquidation for Apex's Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings, will result in a pre-tax gain of $13.3 million for the first quarter of 1997, the company said.

The settlement of the claims will result in the dismissal of pending court actions between Converse and all former owners of Apex except Norwood Venture Corp, from which Converse said it will continue to seek damages for alleged securities fraud in connection with the acquisition.
